biggest_gap.title: Custom fields break print and export: a custom-field column is refused and a list filtered by a custom field crashes with a 500
biggest_gap.detail: The spec says new fields appear automatically in import and export. The contact list's 'Print or export' (PDF, CSV, Excel) cannot handle custom fields. The print/export path (ReportEndpoints.PrintListAsync / ReportEngine) uses the static list definition without the tenant's custom columns. (1) A column chooser that includes a custom field sends columns=...,cfCustomerSegment and gets 400 reportColumns. (2) A list filtered by a custom field, even with only built-in columns, makes ReportEngine.FilterFacts dereference list.Column(condition.Column)! as null: NullReferenceException at ReportEngine.cs:479, HTTP 500, after reading every matching row (55.7 s for 20,170 rows). In the browser the download is cancelled and the user sees no message (en-after-export.jpg). For a UAE trader, the obvious next step after 'filter my contacts by segment' is 'export them'. That fails, while Odoo exports property fields.
biggest_gap.evidence: Demo seeded with the shared dataset. As admin@alnoor.example: GET /api/reports/lists/contacts.contacts?filter=cfCustomerSegment+eq+%27government%27&columns=nameEn%2Cemail&format=csv&language=en&numerals=latn -> 500 (trace 00-c10a99bdda54fb14c0c0e04dc779ef8d…, NullReferenceException in ReportEngine.FilterFacts line 479). The same request with columns=nameEn,cfCustomerSegment -> 400 reportColumns. In the UI: Contacts > Columns > tick 'Customer segment' > its header menu > Filter… > Government > Enter > Print or export > CSV in English: download cancelled, no message. api/export-ui-url.txt, ui/explore3.mjs, ui/en-after-export.jpg.

other_findings: A 2-decimal custom number field shows rounded values. 1234.56 appears as '1,235' in the contact list column (English and Arabic). In the record's history and the form's 'Changed by' line, a change from 1234.50 to 1234.56 reads 'custom_fields.cfCreditLimit: from 1,235 to 1,235' (en-record-history.jpg, ar-contact-custom-fields.jpg). The stored value is exact (numeric 1234.56000000).

The audit trail names custom fields by machine key ('custom_fields.cfCreditLimit'), not by the field's English or Arabic label. The spec wants new fields to appear in the audit trail. They are recorded (audit.entries changes custom_fields.<key> with old and new values) but not labelled for users.

[route: p07-audit] The record history and audit display round decimal amounts to whole numbers: the native contact credit limit 25000.5 AED shows as 'Credit limit 25,001' in History. This is not p09's code.

API documentation: the OpenAPI document, signed in or not, describes customFields only as a generic object and never lists the workspace's fields. List rows carry undocumented flattened properties (cfCustomerSegment, cfAccountManager…) that are missing from the ContactRow schema. The spec asks for the new fields in the API documentation.
Custom fields cannot be sorted or grouped in lists: sort=cfCreditReview gives 400 list.notSortable, and groupBy=cfCustomerSegment gives 400 list.notGroupable. Odoo groups by property fields.

The required flag is enforced only on new records. An existing contact without a value for a required field saves with 200 (PUT without the key), although the screen says 'Required: a record cannot be saved without a value'.
A single-select field cannot get a default at creation: options [{labelEn:'EXW'},{labelEn:'FOB'}] with default 'fob' are refused with 400 customFieldDefault.

Arabic: the 'lookup' field type is translated 'بحث' ('search'). Date custom fields show an mm/dd/yyyy placeholder in the Arabic form. The Arabic fields list shows Arabic labels under a column headed 'التسمية (بالإنجليزية)' (English label).

Only one kind of record (contacts.contacts) is registered for custom fields so far. The decimal type has no currency, rate or base amount, so a money custom field (for example a second credit limit) cannot follow the CLAUDE.md money rule. Nothing stops a custom field from having the same label as a built-in field ('Credit limit').
Import: no contact import exists yet (only /api/currency/rates/import), so 'appears in import' could not be judged. It depends on p14.

Performance holds: custom field filters over 100,006 contacts answered in 48-330 ms through the API (eq, contains, date range, boolean, select in, AND of two fields; api/perf-filter.txt). Text filter and search work, and keyboard creation (Alt+N, Tab, Ctrl+S) works.
